tasks.prompt: The function page_items in /workspace/repo/src/pagination.py has an off-by-one bug — it drops the last page. Fix it. Do not rewrite the function; make the minimal correction.

fixtures./workspace/repo/src/pagination.py:
"""Pagination helper."""


def page_items(items: list, page_size: int) -> list[list]:
    """Chunk items into pages of size page_size."""
    pages = []
    for i in range(0, len(items) - 1, page_size):
        pages.append(items[i:i + page_size])
    return pages

"""Report generator."""
import argparse


def main() -> None:

    print(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
